![][image2]  
*The core 4-step process framework.*  
**Suggested New Copy**

**Headline:** *Smart Automation That \[Turns Inquiries Into Sales\]*

* **Step 1 (Reply) — Instant Chat Answers:** *Reply to incoming chats from WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook \[24/7 with business-trained AI\].*

* **Step 4 (Follow Up) — Smart Follow-Up Reminders:** *Send automatic check-ins and reminders so warm leads \[never slip away or go cold\].*

## **Section 2: 8-Card Feature Overview Grid ("The Tools Behind Better Customer Conversations")**

![][image9]  
**Why We Are Doing It:** Replacing passive software descriptions with concise, action-oriented business outcomes that emphasize speed, team assignment, and revenue.  
**Card 1: All-in-One Team Inbox**

* **Original:** "Manage WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, and Facebook Messenger conversations in one shared workspace with full customer context and team assignment."  
* **New Copy:** *Handle WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook chats from one shared screen. Assign conversations to team members and never miss an incoming message.*

**Card 2: Visual Workflow Automation**

* **Original:** "Build visual workflows for greetings, FAQs, and lead routing to respond promptly and reduce repetitive manual tasks."  
* **New Copy:** *Build drag-and-drop chat flows that greet new inquiries, capture contact info, and route hot leads straight to your sales team.*

**Card 3: 24/7 AI Sales Assistant**

* **Original:** "Deploy smart chatbots trained on your business FAQs to handle customer inquiries 24/7 with smooth handoff to live agents."  
* **New Copy:** *Train an AI agent on your products, pricing, and services. It answers customer questions naturally and books meetings while your team sleeps.*

**Card 4: WhatsApp Broadcast Campaigns**

* **Original:** "Send approved template announcements to opted-in customer lists and monitor delivery and read status in real time."  
* **New Copy:** *Send targeted promotions, seasonal offers, and product launches directly to customer phones with verified high delivery and read rates.*

**Card 5: Smart Lead & Contact CRM**

* **Original:** "Centralize contact profiles, custom tags, and conversation history so your team has complete customer context for every interaction."  
* **New Copy:** *Track every lead's stage, purchase intent, and full chat history in one organized contact card so your team always knows who to follow up with.*

**Card 6: In-Chat Issue Resolution**

* **Original:** "Turn customer conversations into structured support tickets with assigned priorities and statuses to track resolutions effectively."  
* **New Copy:** *Convert customer queries into tracked tickets with priority tags, ensuring customer complaints and requests get resolved without delays.*

**Card 7: Sales & Response Analytics**

* **Original:** "Track message volumes, delivery performance, and team response activity to understand communication trends and improve service."  
* **New Copy:** *Monitor team response times, conversation volumes, and campaign ROI in real time to see exactly how fast your leads turn into customers.*

**Card 8: Zero-Friction Integrations**

* **Original:** "Connect your everyday tools and systems using webhooks and APIs to share customer communication events across your workflow."  
* **New Copy:** *Sync conversations and lead details directly with your favorite CRMs, Google Sheets, and calendar booking tools via webhooks and official APIs.*
